name: Takaoka Toko Co., Ltd.
summary: Takaoka Toko Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in power equipment, metering, GX solutions, and applied optical inspection equipment businesses. It manufactures and sells applied macromolecular electric equipment and components; SCADA systems for electric power networks; and electric equipment, as well as undertakes electrical engineering and construction works, and power lines and telecommunication construction works. The company also engages in the transportation and logistics business; installation of high-voltage instrument transformers; and development, manufacture, and sale of electric power meters, gas instrument transformers, and mold products.
